profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer at GOLDPoint Systems
profile.summary:
I’m a Full-Stack Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience building enterprise applications and solving complex business problems through software. My background includes developing web applications, APIs, and distributed systems using Angular, ASP.NET Core, .NET, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Docker.

I enjoy partnering with stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and have experience across the full software development lifecycle—from design and development to deployment and production support. I’m passionate about continuous learning, creating maintainable software, and delivering solutions that provide measurable value to both users and organizations.

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain full-stack enterprise applications using Angular 21, ASP.NET Core, .NET 10, MVC, and Razor.
• Design and implement solutions within a microservice architecture, enabling shared functionality across multiple business applications.
• Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable software solutions.
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
• Contribute to architectural discussions, code reviews, and engineering best practices to improve system reliability and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · MongoDB · Docker · ASP.NET · Prompt Engineering

positions.locationName: Beverly Hills, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineering Team Lead, Project Manager, & QA
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies · CI/CD · Communication · Manual Testing · Project Planning · Strategic Planning · Team Building · Team Leadership · Teamwork · Test Planning · Analytical Skills

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Agile Methodologies · CI/CD · Manual Testing · Test Planning

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
• Developed an awarding feature in a product credit service, built in React, that checks an award request’s specific credit type, calculates the affected user’s current total of that type, and determines the amount to be awarded, if anything.
• Updated the Younique website’s integrated AR tool—by Holition—using Holition’s  FaceSDK.
• Coded features to support Tax Identification Number entry and validation, during registration, on both the CakePHP front and backends of the website, including new API endpoints in PHP.
• Added CakePHP API endpoints for fetching user addresses and form requirements by market for a registration form.
• Engineered front and backend features to support the creation and download of a user’s payment receipt using the TCPDF PHP library.
• Added additional functionality to an internal React library.
• Fixed over 2,000 ESLint errors in multiple React services as part of a campaign to implement ESLint as a part of the services’ deployment pipelines.
• Completed a large number of general React, jQuery, PHP, and CakePHP frontend tasks and some CakePHP backend tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Jira · Web Application Development · JavaScript · CSS · Full-Stack Development · jQuery · Problem Solving · React.js · REST APIs · Unit Testing · CI/CD · Docker · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Amazon Dynamodb · Responsive Web Design · Scrum · PHP · Back-End Web Development · SQL · SASS · MVC · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Crafted intuitive, dynamic, and visually appealing Angular components using Sass, as well as JSP templates and JavaScript components utilizing JQuery.
• Wrote dependable and comprehensible server-side routing and service logic using Node.js/Express, and Java classes under the Spring framework following MVC methodology.
• Built efficient data management structures and ardently strove for better implementations.
• Integrated RESTful and WebSocket APIs to support new features in developed applications, and integrated with external services, like Drive Google APIs.
• Delved into Python and BASH scripting in a deployment tool that automatically set some configurations for a service used by the application the tool was created for.
• Coded well thought out unit tests intended to catch even the most elusive edge cases.
• Focused on code modularity, short and simple logic, with clear and complete documentation based on current JSDoc and JavaDoc standards.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
• Produced easy to follow and concise test suites for new and existing products and features using TestRail and Xray in Jira.
• Created some automated, end-to-end testing using the Nightwatch.js framework.
• Earned a Part 107 drone pilot certificate and certified internally to act as pilot in command of the large defense drone product.
• Diligently strived for ever higher standards in the testing of company offerings.
• Eagerly explored for edge cases that could compromise safety or customer experience.

positions.title: As-built PV Designer
positions.description:
• Handled calls from installation crews for redesign requests and qualifying PV installations.
• Created as-built documentation and drawings based on qualified installations.
• Occasionally, assisted leadership in building web based tools for the As-built organization.
• Shared expertise with leadership and co-workers when needed.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented—and assisted in refining—a design for a customer facing website feature using
WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
• Helped to catch bugs and made suggestions for improvements on the Banyan's mobile app.
• Bolstered skills in research of programming techniques and technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · WordPress · CSS · Problem Solving · PHP

positions.title: Quality Control Design Technician
positions.description:
• Reviewed design documentation for errors and inconsistencies before sending for permitting.
• Reported findings via pre-established QA reporting standards.
• Helped to support installation crews calling for assistance with redesigns.

positions.title: Lead PV Designer
positions.description:
• Trained and guided CAD Designers under my leadership.
• Qualified PV design documentation and drawings for permitting.
• Handled phone calls and emails from field techs, operations leadership, and sales reps.
• Shared expertise with leadership and CAD Designers when needed.

positions.title: PV Designer
positions.description:
• Created documentation and drawings for residential PV systems.
• Helped Lead CAD Designers qualify documents and drawings of co-workers for permitting.
• Shared expertise with leadership and co-workers as needed.

positions.title: CAD Drafter
positions.description:
• Created drawings showing where equipment and communication lines would be located or run.
• 2D Modeled scale replicas of equipment to be installed.
• Created installation documentation and bills of materials for project sites.
• Worked with floor and warehouse staff to ensure materials and plans were available for installation crews.

positions.title: Evening CAD Manager
positions.description:
• Managed a team of 40+ CAD Designers.
• Handled special projects sent down from leadership.
• Trained and guided Lead CAD Designers in processes and leadership suggestions.

positions.title: Interconnection Technician
positions.description:
• Determined electrical interconnection for residential PV systems.
• Created project documentation for CAD Designers to use for specific needs of each home.
• Helped training staff develop training materials.
• Occasionally assisted leadership in updating and improving computer based tools that were regularly used by CAD Designers.
